rationale: Add explicit job timeouts (60 minutes) to all six job definitions (compile, compile-full, compile-nimble, compile-nimble-full, compile-sys-legacy, compile-sys-legacy-full) to bound runaway executions. The repository's CI history shows typical push-event workflow durations of ~75 minutes with matrix jobs running in parallel across 6 runner slots, so individual matrix cells complete well within 60 minutes. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) demonstrated 26.8% elapsed-time savings on a measured fork by adding a 5-minute timeout to a Node.js lint/typecheck job; the pattern catalogue (pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) reports 12.9%/8.1% VM-time reduction (free/paid) with the precondition that representative successful-duration history exists—which this repository satisfies. The 60-minute limit provides ample headroom over observed per-cell runtimes while catching hung toolchain downloads or build stalls.
